usage: NFL injury designations and expected return dates for every player in this league's pool, keyed by ESPN player id. Joined by player id, never by name. A compact subset of each record is already attached inline as the player's `injury` block in rosters.json, player_index.json and recent_form_rankings.json, so a player's injury travels with them everywhere they appear; this file carries the full detail including the beat note. on_nfl_ir means the NFL team placed the player on injured reserve. in_fantasy_ir_slot means this league's manager parked them in the fantasy IR slot. The two are different and routinely disagree: ir_on_nfl_but_active_slot lists players burning an active roster spot while on NFL IR, and ir_slot_but_not_on_nfl_ir lists fantasy IR slots holding someone the NFL has not designated. expected_return is ESPN's estimate; a date in February means out for the season, and expected_return_label says so in words. A designation of IR-R means designated to return.

4360761.name: Michael Wilson

4038524.name: Gardner Minshew II

4035671.name: Tyler Huntley

4685526.name: Adam Randall

4241476.name: Tyrell Shavers

4430034.name: Xavier Legette
4430034.note: The Panthers designated Legette (knee) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

4678008.name: Jonathon Brooks
4678008.note: The Panthers designated Brooks (core) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

4685278.name: Luther Burden III
4685278.note: Burden has a concussion, head coach Ben Johnson revealed after Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

15168.name: Case Keenum

4257364.name: Zavier Scott
4257364.note: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

4368003.name: Andrei Iosivas
4368003.note: Head coach Zac Taylor said Monday that Iosivas is doing well in his recovery from left thumb surgery, and the Bengals will "continue to work through this week" to determine when the receiver might return from injured reserve, Laurel Pfahler of the Dayton Daily News reports.

4832800.name: Denzel Boston

3122840.name: Deshaun Watson
3122840.note: The Browns announced Wednesday that Watson (concussion) will start Sunday's game against the Texans, Kelsey Russo of the team's official site reports.

4429676.name: Tyler Goodson
4429676.note: Goodson sustained ACL and MCL sprains in his knee during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts, a source tells Todd Archer of ESPN.com.

4426485.name: Jonathan Mingo
4426485.note: Mingo (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's matchup against the Colts, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

4372016.name: Jaylen Waddle
4372016.note: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

4361529.name: Isiah Pacheco
4361529.note: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

3149687.name: Chris Brooks
3149687.note: As Week 10 approaches, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com indicates that Brooks (ankle) may be ready to return from IR.

4259305.name: Bo Melton
4259305.note: Melton exited Sunday's game against the Patriots and is being evaluated for a concussion.

4426496.name: Cade Stover
4426496.note: Stover was a healthy inactive for Sunday's 44-22 win over the Chargers.

4586312.name: Jaylin Noel
4586312.note: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

4360078.name: Alec Pierce
4360078.note: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

2998565.name: Mo Alie-Cox
2998565.note: Alie-Cox is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Dallas due to a groin injury.

4683062.name: Xavier Worthy
4683062.note: Worthy (hamstring) is slated to practice Wednesday, " Pete Sweeney of The Kansas City Star reports.

3139477.name: Patrick Mahomes
3139477.note: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that Mahomes (elbow) is considered day-to-day as this Sunday's game against the Falcons approaches, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

4038941.name: Justin Herbert
4038941.note: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert "should be good to go" for Monday's game at Baltimore after imaging on the quarterback's injured left middle finger returned negative for a fracture, ESPN.com reports.

4612826.name: Ladd McConkey
4612826.note: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh noted Monday that McConkey is viewed as "day to day" with back spasms, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

3123076.name: David Njoku
3123076.note: Njoku (fibula) wasn't activated from IR-designated to return ahead of Sunday's game against the Texans, per the NFL's official transaction log.

4569382.name: Jordan Whittington
4569382.note: Whittington (back) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday.

4570037.name: Terrance Ferguson
4570037.note: Rams head coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday during his appearance on the "Coach McVay Show" that he remains hopeful Ferguson (hamstring/ankle) will return from injured reserve this season, though he was unwilling to guarantee that the tight end will be activated by the time his 21-day evaluation window closes, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports. "I'm reluctant to get too far ahead of anything, just because -- but yes, that is something we'd want to avoid if he's not prepared," McVay said, regarding the possibility of Ferguson being shut down.

4242512.name: Malik Willis
4242512.note: Though Dolphins coach Jeff Hafley said Wednesday that he doesn't have a timetable for the potential return of Willis (abdomen), he does expect the QB back at some point this season, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

4880236.name: Will Kacmarek
4880236.note: Kacmarek is dealing with a quad injury and is questionable to return to Sunday's clash against Detroit.

4239996.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
4239996.note: Head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that the Saints haven't yet determined whether Etienne (hamstring) will return from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Luke Johnson of The New Orleans Times-Picayune reports. "We'll see," Moore said. "He's progressing well. We'll gather some more information and make a decision."

4433970.name: J.J. McCarthy
4433970.note: McCarthy (hip) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

4696981.name: Cam Skattebo
4696981.note: Skattebo (hamstring) was listed as a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

4723820.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
4723820.note: Cooper (ankle) will be limited in Wednesday's practice, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

4035687.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
4035687.note: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

4360438.name: Brandon Aiyuk
4360438.note: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

3895856.name: Christian Kirk
3895856.note: The 49ers placed Kirk (knee) on injured reserve Saturday.

3924327.name: Drew Lock

4430834.name: Jalen McMillan

4361088.name: Colson Yankoff

4361577.name: Dyami Brown

3127586.name: Jeremy McNichols
3127586.note: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
